report.summary: 9 reviewed findings processed: 2 critical, 5 high, 1 medium, 1 low. 3 confirmed, 3 narrowed, 3 needs-evidence. Ordered work items: fix vacuous recall (critical), fix docstring contradiction (high), prevent anchor on deleted files (high), persist accepted items (high), clear meta in refusal receipt (high), add nonce uniqueness guarantee (high), verify graph_delta cross-file dependency (medium), align human field definitions (low).
risks: Fixing vacuous recall may break callers expecting 1.0 for empty fail_to_pass.
Correcting docstring may mislead developers who relied on unconditional extraction.
Filtering deleted files from per_file may change anchor selection behavior in edge cases.
Persisting accepted items may require new file I/O, impacting performance.
Clearing meta in refusal receipt may lose legitimate metadata.
Nonce uniqueness fix may require coordination across distributed callers.
Graph delta dependency check may reveal architectural coupling requiring refactor.
Aligning human field definitions may be unnecessary if no overlap exists.
todos: Implement validation to reject empty fail_to_pass or return 0.0 recall.
Update docstring for type_facts to reflect conditional extraction.
Add filter in per_file construction to exclude files with after_text None.
Implement separate acceptances file or mechanism in drift.py.
Add nonce generation with uniqueness guarantee (e.g., uuid or counter).
Inspect graph_delta.py to determine if it uses typegraph cross-file resolution.
Search for overlapping field names between FEATURE_HUMAN_FIELDS and graph_delta comparisons.

items.title: Fix vacuous recall when fail_to_pass is empty
items.why_now: Critical severity; returns misleading 1.0 recall for empty list, violating contract. Blocks reliable evaluation.

steps.do: Add validation in compute_recall to reject empty fail_to_pass or return 0.0.

items.title: Correct docstring for type_facts extraction condition
items.why_now: Documentation bug misleads developers; high severity.

steps.do: Update comment on FileAnalysis.type_facts to state extraction is conditional on language == 'python'.
steps.verified_by: Run test_type_facts_conditional; confirm docstring matches code.

items.title: Prevent anchor selection on deleted files
items.why_now: High severity; if per_file includes deleted files, anchor may select a deleted file violating rule.

steps.do: Add filter in per_file construction to exclude files with after_text None.
steps.verified_by: Run test_anchor_skips_deleted; ensure anchor never selects deleted file.

items.title: Persist accepted drift items separately
items.why_now: High severity; write_snapshot may lose accepted items if not stored elsewhere.

steps.do: Implement separate acceptances file or mechanism in drift.py to persist accepted items.
steps.verified_by: Run test_accepted_items_persisted; after snapshot, accepted items are recoverable.

items.title: Clear meta fields in refusal receipt to prevent withheld content leak
items.why_now: High severity; withheld content in meta could leak into refusal receipt.

steps.verified_by: Run test_refusal_meta_cleared; meta is empty in refusal receipt.

items.title: Add nonce uniqueness guarantee
items.why_now: High severity; probe collisions if nonces are not unique.

steps.do: Add nonce generation with uniqueness guarantee (e.g., uuid or counter) in build_arrival, build_instruction, etc.
steps.verified_by: Run test_nonce_unique; generate multiple nonces and verify uniqueness.

items.title: Verify graph_delta cross-file dependency and fix if needed
items.why_now: Medium severity; if graph_delta relies on incomplete type graph, delta detection may miss cross-file mutations.

steps.do: Inspect graph_delta.py to determine if it uses typegraph cross-file resolution. If yes, add completeness or build own graph.
steps.verified_by: Run test_graph_delta_cross_file; cross-file mutations are detected.

items.assumption: Assumes graph_delta currently uses typegraph; needs evidence.

items.title: Align human field definitions between inventory and graph_delta
items.why_now: Low severity; potential false positives if field definitions differ.

steps.do: Search for overlapping field names between FEATURE_HUMAN_FIELDS and graph_delta comparisons. If overlap exists, align definitions.
